## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the one [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) a reified invitation concerns — the target the invitee is being asked to attend.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting more than one (it is functional — one event per invitation) and avoid pointing it at a schedule; an invitation is to a concrete occurrence, not to a recurrence generator.

### How to use

- Set exactly one [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md); pair with [`gmeow:invitationInvitee`](gmeow-invitationInvitee.md) for the recipients and the status properties for the response state.
